description: 1099 preparation, recipient delivery, and IRS IRIS A2A e-filing.
_doc: Imported from KisaesDevLab/Vibe-1099 appliance/manifest.yaml (Addendum A). Upstream ships no .appliance/manifest.json yet, so this in-tree copy is authoritative until it does (Phase 5 convention).

optional.name: VIBE_APP_SUBDOMAIN
optional.doc: Operator override for this app's subdomain label. Empty = the manifest default ("1099"). Consumed by the appliance routing (Caddy vhost + Cloudflare Tunnel CNAME/ingress) when DOMAIN_ROUTING_MODE=subdomain-per-app; ignored in single-host mode. Single DNS label — lowercase letters, digits, dashes, no dots.

ui.label: Subdomain
ui.helpText: The <subdomain> in <subdomain>.<your-domain> when routing is 'subdomain per app'. Blank = default ("1099"). Vibe 1099's web SPA is built for a root base, so it REQUIRES subdomain-per-app routing (single-host path-mounting 404s its assets). Saving re-renders routing and re-provisions the tunnel; the app briefly restarts.

optional.name: STAFF_IP_ALLOWLIST
optional.doc: Comma-separated IPs/CIDRs allowed to reach staff APIs. Belt-and-braces for the split-exposure model: staff endpoints refuse tunnel-origin traffic even if a route leaks. Empty = no IP restriction (rely on auth). See the app's docs/appliance-integration.md.

ui.label: Staff API IP allowlist
ui.helpText: Comma-separated IPs or CIDRs (e.g. 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.7). Staff APIs reject any source not on this list — recommended when the recipient portal is public via the tunnel so a leaked staff route still can't be reached from the internet. Leave blank to disable IP gating.

optional.name: TAXBANDITS_ENABLED
optional.doc: Enable the TaxBandits e-file provider path (1099 batch e-filing). Requires provider credentials; leave 0 until the firm is onboarded (TCC/ATS).

ui.label: TaxBandits e-file
ui.helpText: Turn on to route 1099 e-filing through TaxBandits. Requires firm onboarding + provider credentials (see the app's docs/firm-onboarding.md). Default off.

firstLogin.note: Vibe 1099 has no appliance-provisioned default login yet. Its `pnpm seed` script (inside vibe-1099-api) creates admin@demo.firm / vibe1099-demo-password ALONG WITH demo firm/payer/recipient data — for evaluation only; do NOT run it on a production install. Firm onboarding (first admin, TCC/ATS): see the app's docs/firm-onboarding.md.
